items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson listed as full participant in Wednesday practice, first time since ankle injury. Corroborated as expected to play vs Bills.
items.why: First full practice since Week 4 ankle injury; Rapoport confirms first full since injury.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; major upgrade for associated skill players.
items.opportunity: Increased efficiency and volume for WRs/TEs/RBs with healthy Lamar.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participants in Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder for Gibbs, ankle for St. Brown; monitor Thursday/Friday.
items.implication: Potential limited or questionable status; watch for upgrades to backups if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated role for David Montgomery and Jameson Williams.

items.text: Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve; signed RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.why: Injury leading to IR; corresponding roster move.
items.implication: Clears path in Eagles backfield amid Barkley issues.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Saquon Barkley if healthy or Blue/handcuffs.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest. Expected available Week 8.
items.why: Maintenance/rest plus ankle; believed not significant.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT reverse Tee Higgins/Chase Brown usage spikes.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba truly special: loses Kubiak, few dynamic threats, DCs shading, stadium knows ball going to him, yet rips 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Massive overperformance vs opportunity despite coaching/loss of help and coverage.
items.implication: Sustainable elite WR1 production; hold/start with confidence ROS.
items.opportunity: Route/target share elite even in tough spots.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle suffered aggravation of previous chest injury on reverse last week; status for Sunday vs Chiefs TBD based on practice.
items.why: Chest injury aggravated; practice will determine availability.
items.implication: Monitor daily; potential absence boosts other DEN WRs/RBs.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated targets for Courtland Sutton, Pat Bryant or RBs.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Very excited for Declan Doyle cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite efficiency under backup QB; Lamar return multiplies.
items.implication: Massive upside unlock Week 8+ with Lamar full.
items.opportunity: Higher YPRR, targets, red-zone with mobile QB.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (Cardinals injury report).
items.why: Appeared on Wednesday report as returning.
items.implication: Trending toward availability; monitor for active.
items.opportunity: Potential RB depth/role in ARI if clears.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Give me Olave. I’d rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer selling proven but perhaps peaking Olave over unproven rookie Tyson.
items.implication: Trade candidate if value high; roster preference for upside rookie.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be in for big day vs Vikings defense sure to pressure Goff.
items.why: Matchup exploitation vs pressure-heavy Vikings; TE upside.

items.text: Texans claimed former Cowboys RB Emari Demercado on waivers; corresponding move placed WR Jaylin Noel on IR (toe).
items.implication: Depth addition for HOU RB; Noel out extended.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/depth for HOU backs if injuries.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Designated return from chest IR; crowded SEA backfield with Charbonnet etc.
items.implication: Stash/monitor role; not automatic start due to depth chart competition.
items.opportunity: Potential carries if earns role post-return.
items.conflict: Prior benching and crowded room limits immediate upside.
corroboration: Seahawks HC comments on designate return

items.text: Time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield; discussed return and role with Levitan/Silva.
items.why: Return performance + coach comments on earned touches/explosiveness; committee but favorite for volume.
items.implication: Waiver priority/add; potential RB2/FLEX in plus matchups.
items.opportunity: Carries/targets in three-headed but Coleman niche lead.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given defense/schedule/talent.
items.why: Concentration of talent + schedule + defensive woes driving elite scoring.
items.implication: Start all core Lions skill with high confidence; Gibbs clear RB1.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry shares in positive scripts.
items.conflict: Gibbs/St. Brown DNP Wednesday creates short-term uncertainty.
